messages.subject: A RHadoop google plus community
parts:
Hi,
you may not be aware yet that Google Plus has a new feature called Communites. While this group remains the main forum for discussions about the project, I started as an experiment a RHadoop community. I am particularly interested in the possibilities that are not available to google groups, such as Hangouts. If you are a plus user or don't mind becoming one, please join me there. Thanks


Antonio
